name: Sophie
source:
It follows the story of Sophie and her Father whilst they enjoy a weekend getaway. Her father's troubled marriage with her mother will play an important part of how their relationship develops through the course of the trip.

[From [url=https://www.patreon.com/tastygames]Patreon[/url]]
translation:
故事讲述索菲和父亲一起度过周末旅行。在旅途中，她父母之间不睦的婚姻将对两人关系的发展起到重要作用。
